# `accepts` and `on` must match, and every agent needs a goal.
# (from diagnostics_golden)
! exec metagente check mismatch.ag
stderr 'agent A accepts `one` but nothing says what to do with it'
stderr '`on two` has no matching `accepts two` line'
stderr 'Found 2 problems\.'

! exec metagente check nogoal.ag
stderr 'agent A has no goal'
stderr 'Fix: add a line under `agent A`'

-- mismatch.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  accepts one
  on two
    reply "x"
-- nogoal.ag --
agent A
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "x"
